name: KV Cache Quantization & Vector Quantization
core_idea: Reduce KV cache memory by lowering the numerical precision of stored K/V vectors: scalar quantization (KIVI: per-channel/per-token INT2/INT4) or vector quantization (VQKV: Residual Simple VQ mapping each vector to codebook indices with on-demand reconstruction). QuantSpec extends this to speculative decoding with a hierarchical INT4 cache (upper/lower 4-bit halves) so the draft model uses INT4 and the target reconstructs INT8. The trade-off is compression ratio vs. reconstruction error and the overhead of codebooks/dequantization; scalar methods are training-free, while VQ requires lightweight codebook training.
